text.description_html:
Laurey 74766, Aventura Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull

The Aventura Cabinet Pull has 5 inch mounting centers and a beautiful Oil Rubbed Bronze finish. This Aventura Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull has an easy to care for design, making it an ideal handle for high traffic kitchen cabinets. The 5 Inch Oil Rubbed Bronze Aventura Cabinet Pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection of transitional cabinet hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Aventura Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 74766 128mm Pull Aventura Oil Rubbed Bronze:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 5" (128mm)
  • Overall Length: 5-1/4"
  • Width: 1/2"
  • Projection: 7/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
